mapper.insert: INSERT INTO finance_receivable (receivable_no, source_type, source_id, order_id, customer_id, customer_name_snapshot, settlement_customer_id, settlement_customer_name_snapshot, entry_type, original_receivable_id, amount, event_at, reason, due_date, credit_rule_snapshot, version, deleted, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{receivableNo}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{orderId}, #{customerId}, #{customerNameSnapshot}, #{settlementCustomerId}, #{settlementCustomerNameSnapshot}, #{entryType}, #{originalReceivableId}, #{amount}, #{eventAt}, #{reason}, #{dueDate}, #{creditRuleSnapshot, typeHandler=com.xsy.scm.common.json.JsonbObjectMapTypeHandler}, 0, FALSE, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (source_type, source_id) WHERE deleted = FALSE DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, receivable_no, source_type, source_id, order_id, customer_id, settlement_customer_id, settlement_customer_name_snapshot, due_date, credit_rule_snapshot, customer_name_snapshot, entry_type, original_receivable_id, amount, event_at, reason, version, deleted, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM finance_receivable WHERE source_type = 'SALES_ORDER' AND source_id = #{salesOrderId} AND entry_type = 'NORMAL' AND deleted = FALSE

SELECT r.id AS receivableId, r.receivable_no AS receivableNo, r.order_id AS orderId, r.customer_id AS customerId, r.settlement_customer_id AS settlementCustomerId, r.customer_name_snapshot AS customerNameSnapshot, r.entry_type AS entryType, r.amount, so.seller_id AS sellerId FROM finance_receivable r LEFT JOIN sales_order so ON so.id = r.order_id AND so.deleted = FALSE WHERE r.id = #{targetId} AND r.entry_type = 'NORMAL' AND r.deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE OF r
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM finance_receivable WHERE original_receivable_id = #{originalReceivableId} AND entry_type = 'RED' AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT * FROM finance_receivable WHERE id = #{receivableId} AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.sql: SELECT r.id AS receivableId, r.receivable_no AS receivableNo, r.order_id AS orderId, so.order_no AS orderNo, r.customer_id AS customerId, r.customer_name_snapshot AS customerName, r.settlement_customer_id AS settlementCustomerId, r.settlement_customer_name_snapshot AS settlementCustomerName, r.source_type AS sourceType, r.source_id AS sourceId, r.entry_type AS entryType, r.original_receivable_id AS originalReceivableId, original.receivable_no AS originalReceivableNo, r.amount, CASE WHEN r.entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN r.amount - red.redAmount ELSE 0 END AS netAmount, CASE WHEN r.entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN written.writtenOffAmount ELSE 0 END AS writtenOffAmount, CASE WHEN r.entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN GREATEST(r.amount - red.redAmount - written.writtenOffAmount, 0) ELSE 0 END AS openAmount, CASE WHEN r.entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN GREATEST(written.writtenOffAmount - (r.amount - red.redAmount), 0) ELSE 0 END AS overAppliedAmount, CASE WHEN r.entry_type <> 'NORMAL' THEN NULL WHEN written.writtenOffAmount = 0 THEN 'OPEN' WHEN GREATEST(r.amount - red.redAmount - written.writtenOffAmount, 0) = 0 AND GREATEST(written.writtenOffAmount - (r.amount - red.redAmount), 0) = 0 THEN 'SETTLED' ELSE 'PARTIAL' END AS settleState, r.event_at AS eventAt, r.due_date AS dueDate, r.reason FROM finance_receivable r JOIN sales_order so ON so.id = r.order_id AND so.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN finance_receivable original ON original.id = r.original_receivable_id AND original.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(red.amount), 0) AS redAmount FROM finance_receivable red WHERE red.original_receivable_id = r.id AND red.entry_type = 'RED' AND red.deleted = FALSE ) red ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN wo.entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN wo.amount WHEN wo.entry_type = 'REVERSE' THEN -wo.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS writtenOffAmount FROM finance_write_off wo WHERE wo.target_type = 'RECEIVABLE' AND wo.target_id = r.id AND wo.deleted = FALSE ) written ON TRUE
mapper.select: WHERE r.original_receivable_id = #{originalReceivableId} AND r.entry_type = 'RED' AND r.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY r.event_at, r.id
